results.content: Consumer prices were up 3.7 percent in July from a year earlier, according to the Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of inflation, the Personal Consumption Expenditure price index. That was the same rate as in June, and still well above the Fed’s target of 2 percent annual inflation.
results.title: PCE Index Shows Inflation Remained Elevated in July Amid High Energy Costs - The New York Times
